pages.text: A tube network runs at low pressure on its own. Each carrier a station sends holds up to $(ec_config:carrier_size_unpressured) items, and the station has a $(ec_config:carrier_ticks) tick delay before sending the next.$(br2)A Pressurizer anywhere on the network raises it to high pressure while it has fuel. Carriers then send $(ec_config:carrier_size_pressured), and stations send them with a $(ec_config:carrier_pressured_ticks) tick delay. Autotubes are not

affected by pressure.$(br2)Right-click it to add coal or charcoal; hoppers can feed it too. Valid fuel items provide 128 high pressure carriers each. Tubes can connect to it on any side but its front.$(br2)The teletype's catalogue tooltip shows whether its network is at high or low pressure.
